name: YouTube Summary with ChatGPT & Claude
summary: Summarises YouTube videos, web articles and PDFs and offers the video transcript when one exists, using several AI models including ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral and Gemini.
audience: Learners and researchers who want the key points of long videos and articles quickly.
pros: Covers YouTube videos, web articles and PDFs
Summaries can include timestamps that jump to that part of the video
Offers the transcript when one is available
cons: The listing says it offers in-app purchases, so some features may be paid
The listing's privacy section says it handles personally identifiable information and website content
pricing_note: Described as a free extension; the listing also says it offers in-app purchases.
alternatives: YoutubeDigest: summarize and translate using ChatGPT
